title: The roadmap's in-progress check sees every live lane
why: Owner, Nov 2 00:00 CST: the roadmap and the live work must stay in step.
note: Measured Nov 2 00:08 CST, first build with the live file (triage had published without one, so the check read unknown): 18 in-progress steps flagged, most of them false. Causes: (1) 15 lane sessions carry the short repo tag claude-settings, but the check wants the full GitHub name; (2) roll-out lanes run in another repo carry that repo's tag, so claude-settings steps r5, r2, r4 and o3 never match; (3) a lane tagged with another step id (one-model-rule's lane carries explore-audit-marker). Fix: one tag form at session start (the coordinator's create step), a roll-out lane also carries this roadmap's tag, and triage publishes with the live file every time. Guard basis: measured. Ready: no open question.
